{# Browser tab title: the home page shows just the site name, other pages show "page title - site name" (a plain hyphen). #} {%- extends "!layout.html" %} {%- block htmltitle %} {%- if pagename == root_doc %} {{ docstitle|striptags|e }} {%- else %} {{ title|striptags|e }} - {{ docstitle|striptags|e }} {%- endif %} {%- endblock %} {# Coming soon pages: keep them out of Google until the post is written. #} {%- block extrahead %} {{ super() }} {#- Link previews: description and picture (PAGE_DESCRIPTIONS in conf.py, _static/og-image.png). #} {%- set page_title = docstitle if pagename == root_doc else (title|striptags) %} {%- set page_desc = page_descriptions.get(pagename, page_descriptions["index"]) %} {# Light only: also resets visitors who picked dark mode when the site still had the button. #} {%- if pagename in coming_soon_pages %} {# no "Edit on GitHub" link to the draft #} {%- elif pagename in noindex_pages %} {# teaser page (NOINDEX_PAGES in conf.py) #} {%- endif %} {%- endblock %}
